text:
Ava (CSM): Quick sync on Cohort 7 preview enrollment — offered 28 seats, 19 accepted, 12 provisioned. We had 5 no-shows at kickoff and 3 stalled on SSO attribute mapping. Concern: activation velocity looks soft; if we don’t kick these accounts over the next 7 days renewal signals may dip. Assigning owners for triage and re-engagement?

Diego (Success Eng): I can take SSO work. Drop the three accounts and the error logs and I’ll triage.

Ava (CSM): Accounts: Priya@acme (Priya, Acme Corp), marcus-fin (Marcus), and an unnamed contact who filed ticket #C7-402. Error is an attribute mismatch (email vs subject). Roster (view): https://redwood-internal.docs/preview-cohort7/roster

Priya (Acme Corp): Confirmed. Our IdP requires the NameID to be email and we currently return uid. Security wants SAML attributes explicit. I can join a deep-dive tomorrow morning.

Ivy (Onboarding): I’ll host a 30-min SSO troubleshooting session. Diego, can you bring the mapping snippet and a minimal test payload?

Diego (Success Eng): Mapping snippet: ```saml_config: { nameid_format: email, attributes: ["email","groups","department"] }``` Test command: `curl -X POST https://preview.redwood.ai/sso/test -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @saml-payload.json` — worked in my sandbox. I’ll attach sample payload in the call.

Ava (CSM): Ivy please schedule. Priority: Priya and Marcus. If SSO resolved this week we likely convert 2 more active seats.

Ivy (Onboarding): Proposing Tue 10:30 PT or Wed 2pm PT. Sending invites now.

ops-bot: calendar invite created: Preview-Cohort7-SSO-Triage 34 Tue 10:30 PT 34 attendees: Priya (Acme Corp), Ivy (Onboarding), Diego, Ava. ICS: https://calendar.redwood/event/preview-c7-sso

Priya (Acme Corp): Tue 10:30 PT works for our team. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Ava (CSM): On the five no-shows: three had schedule conflicts, two asked to defer onboarding. Plan: a short 10-min re-engagement demo + a one-pager with recommended prompt recipes tailored to finance workflows. Diego, can you draft the prompt one-pager and a 90-sec demo script?

Diego (Success Eng): Will draft and drop into this thread in ~2 hours. I’ll include example prompts, expected outputs, and a short troubleshooting checklist.

Ava (CSM): Also adding a renewal-risk rule: accounts with <30% activation by day 21 get flagged for AE outreach. Marcus is borderline — heavy potential but blocked by SSO. If not activated by Friday tag for AE check.

Ivy (Onboarding): I’ll add CRM tag `needs-AE-check` for Marcus if not activated by EOD Friday.

Ava (CSM): Feedback capture: want a 1-question pulse after a user’s first successful run: "Did Redwood reduce time-to-answer for X task? (Yes / No)" with optional comment. Who can hook this micro-survey into the in-app flow?

Diego (Success Eng): I can wire a webhook to pop the micro-survey after the run completes, then POST results to our feedback endpoint. Will coordinate with Product to add the UI prompt.

Ava (CSM): Great. Quick action recap for visibility: 
- Ivy: schedule & run SSO triage call Tue 10:30 PT (invites sent).
- Diego: attach sample SAML payload, post prompt one-pager + demo script (due today).
- Ivy: tag Marcus in CRM for AE check if not activated by Fri EOD.
- Diego + Product: implement 1-question pulse after first successful run.
- Ava: run re-engagement demo invites for deferred seats.

Diego (Success Eng): Also note: last week there was a tokenized queue spike on Dedicated pool during a demo window. I will set an alert for sustained >=60% utilization in demo windows and monitor while we run re-engagement demos.

Priya (Acme Corp): Thanks all, looking forward to the call. If we get SSO sorted we’ll run scenario tests and provide feedback on prompt outputs.

Ava (CSM): Thanks team. Loop back here after the SSO call and when the prompt doc is posted. :thumbsup:
